summary: The prepared base deterministically retains the original ordering defect: HiCache hand-over precedes prepare_for_extend and mixed prefill input_ids remain deferred until forward entry. At the exact candidate commit, all focused regressions pass and independent instrumentation shows mixed prefill H2D issuance before the burst record. A real gfx950 run also verifies late decode-token gathering, correct concatenation, one-shot staging consumption, and safe fallback after replacement of the CPU source. The candidate fixes the source-level ordering contract; H100 TP=8 multi-GiB timing and performance remain unmeasured environment limitations, not observed functional counterexamples.

tests.what_was_measured: At base 358c163, ready_to_load_host_cache occurs before prepare_for_extend and mixed prefill H2D remains in resolve_forward_inputs; contract_failure=True.
Exact candidate 0304e79: 53 tests passed, covering ordering, pure/mixed prefill, metadata staging, DP counts, speculative exclusions, fallback, and idempotent hand-over.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, observed mixed_prefill_h2d before burst_record, result [3,5,8,13], one-shot staged consumption, and replacement-source fallback result [9,10,13].
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; real device tensors were staged, gathered, concatenated, copied back, and synchronized.

remaining_limitations: The reported 8 x NVIDIA H100 TP=8 architecture was unavailable; only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was assigned.
No qualifying hierarchical-cache model weights, multi-GiB host-cache burst, nsys trace, TP all-reduce, or end-to-end performance measurement was available.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.

The first adversarial run failed because the review fixture reused a consumed batch whose mix_running_indices had been cleared; a corrected fresh mixed state passed, and both logs were retained outside the checkout.
